item.title: Tampa's Judeo Christian Health Center prescribing hope for uninsured working patients
item.description: For far too many hardworking people, getting sick is terrifying because health insurance is out of reach. At the Judeo Christian Health Center in Tampa, volunteers are stepping in to fill that gap.Doctor Mark Morris spent his career as a pediatrician, and instead of easing into retirement, he now treats uninsured patients who have nowhere else to go.
